name: fleetwide_mem20
description: Fleetwide Mem20 rollout: every bot gets isolated mem20 namespace, decision persistence, and crash recovery without session hunting. (A2A setup moved to separate a2a_setup roadmap.)

name.name: Phase 1: Rename releasecoach → coach (directory + SOUL header)
Phase 2: Add mem20 MCP to all profile configs (13 profiles missing it)
Phase 3: Create isolated mem20 namespace for each bot
Phase 4: Add fleetwide rule: every bot stores decisions to mem20 immediately
Phase 5: Test — crash a bot, verify resume from mem20 without session search

retroactive_audit.notes: Phase 1 (rename releasecoach→coach) completed. Phase 2 (add mem20 MCP to all profiles) completed. Phase 3 (isolated namespaces) in progress.
